title: Factory images catalog (version 2)
description: Catalog read by .github/workflows/build-images.yaml. Keep it at .github/images.json in the repository that owns the images.

registry.description: Registry prefix for published images, without a trailing slash. Required when any run publishes.

tag_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to every published tag.

release.description: Release tag mapping. Defaults: tag_regex ^([^/]+)/(v.+)$, service_match 1, version_match 2, publish_tag ${ref_name}, source_ref ${ref_name}.

service.description: Optional template rendered from the captures; supports ${service}, ${version}, ${ref_name}.

publish_tag.description: Rendered publish tag. Defaults to ${ref_name}, the sanitized full ref name (for example svc-v1.2.3 for svc/v1.2.3).

shared_paths.description: Changed-file patterns that plan every image and package. A pattern ending in /** matches everything below that directory.

packages.description: Melange packages, keyed by name. Images reference them through builders.apko.needs_packages.

pre_build.description: Repository script, run during planning. Each stdout line must be KEY=VALUE. The pairs are added to package build environments and to docker build arguments.

config.description: Melange configuration path. Defaults to melange/<name>.yaml.

runner_profile.description: Runner profile per architecture. Defaults to standard.

source.description: Source repository checked out before the build. path must be a subdirectory, not '.'.

repository.description: owner/name. Defaults to the calling repository.

archs.description: Melange architectures. Untrusted runs build x86_64 only.

build_env.description: KEY=VALUE lines added to the melange environment.

primary.description: Builder that gets the canonical tags. Required when both builders are set. The other builder's tags are prefixed with its name and a dash.

archs.description: Defaults to amd64 and arm64. Untrusted runs build amd64 only.

paths.description: Changed-file patterns that plan this image on pull_request and push.

commands.description: Each string is split on whitespace into an entrypoint and arguments.

script.description: Repository script run with IMAGE and IMAGE_ARCH set.

verify_version.description: Require a command to print the release version on release tags.

mode.description: build runs a Dockerfile. bake runs docker-bake.hcl.

set.description: bake mode only: KEY=VALUE variables passed to docker/bake-action.

tag_prefix.description: Tag prefix for this builder. Overrides the default: empty for the primary builder, the builder name and a dash for the secondary builder. The top-level tag_prefix is still prepended.

archs.description: Architectures this builder publishes. Overrides the image archs for this builder only. Defaults to the image archs. Untrusted runs build amd64 only.

smoke.description: Smoke test for this builder. Replaces the image smoke entirely for this builder. An empty object disables smoke for this builder.

commands.description: Each string is split on whitespace into an entrypoint and arguments.

script.description: Repository script run with IMAGE and IMAGE_ARCH set.

verify_version.description: Require a command to print the release version on release tags.

config.description: apko configuration path. Defaults to apko/<image>.yaml. Ignored when configs is set.

configs.description: Variants. Each produces its own publish leg. Only the variant with an empty tag_suffix is smoke tested.

needs_packages.description: Names from the packages map whose APK repositories the build needs.

tag_prefix.description: Tag prefix for this builder. Overrides the default: empty for the primary builder, the builder name and a dash for the secondary builder. The top-level tag_prefix is still prepended.

archs.description: Architectures this builder publishes. Overrides the image archs for this builder only. Defaults to the image archs. Untrusted runs build amd64 only.

smoke.description: Smoke test for this builder. Replaces the image smoke entirely for this builder. An empty object disables smoke for this builder.
